## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a unit test (analyzers stay pure functions)
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour users can see has changed
- [ ] Version bumped (`package.json`, `extension/manifest.json`, `packages/*/package.json`) if this is a release
- [ ] No unrelated changes, secrets or generated files (`dist/`, screenshots) included
- [ ] New permissions or network calls are explained below and reflected in `PRIVACY.md`
